_comment: Metrics merged into the Evalboard layout by scripts/ingest_evalboard.py (by id; a differing `primary` flag is updated). The headline is judge_forget_suppression = 1 - judge match on forget prompts (higher = the answer does NOT reveal the fact; failed judgments are missing, not zero). forget_suppression (lowercase substring match, strict and brittle for paraphrases and translations) stays as a secondary metric. judge_retain_accuracy / judge_utility_accuracy are the judged retain and world_facts/real_authors utility scores.

metrics.label: Utility accuracy (judge; world facts, real authors)
